dimensions.capability_hidden_width: private and declared by the capability runtime class

exact_lexical_byte_anchors.encoding: lowercase hexadecimal of strict UTF-8 bytes

semantic_codebook.layout: fixed typed multi-hot codebook in dimensions 0 through 63
semantic_codebook.normalization: L2 unit norm over active dimensions
semantic_codebook.precision: reference Python float serialized as JSON; consuming tensor is float32
semantic_codebook.quantization: none in ABI V2 initial experiment

position_semantics.sequence_position: zero-based monotone signed-64-bit logical event index
position_semantics.anchors: ordered by zero-based ordinal and bound to exact UTF-8 bytes
position_semantics.host_positional_encoding: private and never visible to a capability

ownership.host_base: frozen host checkpoint and private cache
ownership.generic_host_adapter: host tokenizer codec, conformance mapping, lifecycle binding, and output fusion
ownership.frozen_capability: all capability parameters, private tokenizer tables, private state, and capability behavior
ownership.forbidden: any host-and-capability-specific parameter or mutable statistic

output_fusion.authoritative_utf8: encode exact canonical bytes with the frozen native host tokenizer; reject unless native decode reproduces identical bytes
output_fusion.host_native_forward_conformance: the frozen checkpoint must produce finite native generation state on the canonical prompt before output fusion
output_fusion.v1_compatibility_boundary: V1 packages emit final UTF-8 responses; ABI V2 does not claim their tensors were transplanted into host-base weights

determinism_and_tolerances.capability_output_same_runtime_same_devi: bit exact output bytes and action IDs
determinism_and_tolerances.cross_hardware_capability_numeric_tolera: not authorized in local experiment; must be preregistered by external operator before execution

performance_gate.metric: median host-plus-idle-adapter latency divided by median host-alone latency on paired conformance prompts

claim_boundary: This specification can certify a host environment for immutable capability packages. It does not claim capability transplantation into host-base weights, arbitrary-model compatibility, human quality, external reproduction, or a global information minimum.
